targetCase.objective: 验证 seeded competitor carry-forward guard 上线后，Discovery replay 在允许扩展更多竞品的同时，不会让 CEO seeded competitors 从后续引用中静默消失。

preconditions: SP-202A has been implemented by ChiefTechnologyOfficer.
Focused self-test for the guard has completed.
Current Discovery baseline evidence is preserved or archived before replay.
The intake and case competitorReference remain unchanged for replay.
executionOrder: CEOChiefOfStaff verifies baseline preservation or archive readiness.
CEOChiefOfStaff verifies seeded competitors are unchanged in intake and case.
CPO reruns Discovery against the same intake.
CEOChiefOfStaff verifies catalog, brief, and landscape coverage for all seeded competitors.
If all seeded competitors are covered, record pass; otherwise mark revision-required or block.
acceptanceCriteria: All seeded competitors appear in reference-source-catalog.json.
All seeded competitors appear in discovery-reference-functional-brief.md or are explicitly carried into problem decomposition.
All seeded competitors appear in discovery-competitor-landscape.md.
Additional competitors are allowed only if seeded competitors remain covered.
Baseline evidence remains available for before/after comparison.
failureConditions: Any seeded competitor is missing from catalog.
Any seeded competitor is missing from brief or decomposition.
Any seeded competitor is missing from landscape.
Baseline evidence was deleted without an archive copy.
Replay output was manually patched around the guard instead of being produced through the guarded path.

recommendedDisposition.pass: Keep the replay output and allow the workflow to conclude that the guard meets its first validation target.
recommendedDisposition.revisionRequired: Route the failure back into WORKFLOW-002 and keep the platform case frozen at Discovery until CTO addresses the guard gap.
recommendedDisposition.blocked: If baseline preservation is broken, stop validation and reconstruct the baseline/archive path before replaying again.

guardrails: Do not delete the current Discovery evidence before validation.
Do not treat expanded competitor scope as a substitute for seeded competitor coverage.
Do not let CEOChiefOfStaff become the default guard implementer.
Do not treat replay pass as production release readiness.
